qc_tranchant_left.blurb: Tranchant - Left is the western end of Montagne du Tranchant, the busiest cliff in the Lanaudiere hills, roughly an hour north of Montreal. Thirteen routes are spread across this section, nine of them bolted sport lines and four traditional, including a longer multi-pitch outing. Grades run from the easy 5.7s through the 5.10s to a few lines in the low 5.12 range, so a mixed group will find something. The wider cliff faces southwest and tends to dry quickly after rain. A shaded platform sits at the far left edge of the wall. Rockfall is a real concern here, so wear a helmet even while belaying.
